defaults.video_script: Six days before the Ballon d'Or, Kylian Mbappe has crushed another major vote. He won the twenty twenty-six Onze d'Or with forty-eight point two percent, while Joao Neves finished on eleven point nine and Kvaratskhelia on ten point eight. Mbappe topped both La Liga and the Champions League for goals, then won the World Cup Golden Boot. Is Monday now his night?
